deep_dive.executive_summary: This refresh re-anchors on the FY2025 20-F filed 2026-04-29, still the newest SEC document in the folder after the 2026-06-18 EDGAR poll returned 0 new filings. XP is Brazil's #1 independent investment platform: R$1.49 trillion client assets, 4.7 million active clients, adjusted net income R$5.2 billion (+15%), and net inflows R$94.3 billion. Cards and lending cross-sell are embedded growth levers; the Other segment lost R$2.5 billion gross (~13% of revenue), a drag we watch but do not haircut in base owner cash yet. News cites Q1 2026 buyback, dividend, and CFO transition; no 6-K is in the...
